description: WESkit (master of 2026-07, Snakemake 9.16.3): RunLog.outputs is {"filesystem": [...]}, the files of the working directory of the run, relative to it, in the order of the file system, and, with S3, presigned URLs of the same files (bucket: the first four characters of the run ID), which carry credentials and are ignored. Matches are sorted by code point (B before a). Captured from a real run; run ID anonymised, signatures redacted.
